# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1635
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1635
- **Title**: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1632` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +46
- **Deletions**: -31
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T15:25:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T17:23:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

- **Author**: ai-teammate

- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T17:23:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

import subprocess

def base_lines(path):
    out = subprocess.run(['git','show','f'+'be046d09'[:-9]+'' if False else 'origin/main:'+path], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    return out.stdout.splitlines(keepends=True)

    by_file.setdefault(path, []).append((bno, cno))

- **Author**: ai-teammate

- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T17:23:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1635
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1635
- **Title**: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1632` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +46
- **Deletions**: -31
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T15:25:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T17:23:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1635
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1635
- **Title**: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1632` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +46
- **Deletions**: -31
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T15:25:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T17:23:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1635
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1635
- **Title**: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1632` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +46
- **Deletions**: -31
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T15:25:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T17:23:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

- **Author**: ai-teammate

- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T17:23:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1635
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1635
- **Title**: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1632` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +46
- **Deletions**: -31
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T15:25:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T17:23:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1635
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1635
- **Title**: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1632` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +46
- **Deletions**: -31
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T15:25:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T17:23:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1635
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1635
- **Title**: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1632` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +46
- **Deletions**: -31
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T15:25:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T17:23:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. ### Fix

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.

- **Author**: ai-teammate

- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T17:23:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).

- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1635
- **Title**: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1632` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +46
- **Deletions**: -31
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T15:25:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T17:23:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1635
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1635
- **Title**: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1632` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +46
- **Deletions**: -31
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T15:25:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T17:23:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1635
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1635
- **Title**: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1632` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +46
- **Deletions**: -31
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T15:25:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T17:23:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1635
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1635
- **Title**: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1632` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +46
- **Deletions**: -31
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T15:25:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T17:23:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1635
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1635
- **Title**: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1632` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +46
- **Deletions**: -31
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T15:25:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T17:23:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1635
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1635
- **Title**: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1632` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +46
- **Deletions**: -31
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T15:25:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T17:23:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

- **PR #**: 1635
