- **Title**: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1632` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +46
- **Deletions**: -31
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T15:25:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T17:23:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1635
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1635
- **Title**: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1632` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +46
- **Deletions**: -31
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T15:25:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T17:23:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

### Root Cause

Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).

- **PR #**: 1635
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1635
- **Title**: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1632` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +46
- **Deletions**: -31
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T15:25:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T17:23:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1635
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1635
- **Title**: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1632` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +46
- **Deletions**: -31
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T15:25:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T17:23:56Z

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

## PR Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

# pr-1635: gh-1632 [GOAL] Stuck-call recovery that fires: tool_stuck must escalate to cancel/retry/background-convert — fa 1.0.580 hung 27 min on a dead git fetch until a human poked it

## Description

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/cli_config_test.dart` + `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart` gh-1632 I1 tests — failed pre-fix (`Expected: autonomous, Actual: advisory`), pass post-fix.
- Full suite `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate): 10986 passed, 10 skipped (env-conditional), 0 failures.

### Notes

- Behavior change: default-config REPL/TUI sessions now auto-cancel a stuck call, retry once, and convert the retry to a background job instead of flag-and-wait; owners wanting flag-only set `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory`.
- Thresholds untouched — a declared-15-min `flutter test` running 6 min is still not stuck (AC7). Recovery budget stays the shipped gh-1054 shape; the 1.5×-threshold cap sketch is left to the owner.
- Adjacent gap, unchanged: the desktop-app wiring passes the raw config, so an unconfigured app host gets no supervision at all — it never emits `tool_stuck`, so I1 is not violated; defaulting it is a separate decision.

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).

### Root Cause

Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

Closes #1632
### Root Cause

- `AgentCliConfig.effectiveStuckTool()` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`) forced `StuckFollowUpMode.advisory` on every non-headless host when no explicit `agent.stuckTool:` was configured. The gh-1054 supervision machine is intact — the fa 1.0.580 incident session simply ran it in advisory mode, where the threshold only emits `tool_stuck` and never cancels/retries/converts: stuck flag at 17:10:52, then 27 minutes of heartbeats until the owner's manual steering soft-yielded the call. Violated invariant I1 (`advisory` = explicit opt-out only, never an implicit interactive default).

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`: `effectiveStuckTool()` now returns the autonomous default in EVERY mode when unconfigured; explicit `agent.stuckTool:` still wins, so `followUp: advisory` stays a deliberate opt-out. Config persistence unchanged (defaults are never written).

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),

  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one

  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.

factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),

  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).

  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.

  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),

- ⚠️ **IMPORTANT (automated review) — stale dartdocs contradicting the new default:** all three flagged docs updated to the gh-1632 I1 stance (autonomous default in EVERY mode; `advisory` = explicit opt-out only):
  - `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart` — `headlessRun` field doc no longer claims it "decides the DEFAULT supervision mode"; now states it does NOT select the supervision default since gh-1632.
  - `lib/src/agent/agent_loop_stuck_supervision.dart` — the advisory paragraph no longer frames advisory as the implicit interactive default ("a human is present"); now an explicit opt-out, with the incident rationale (the 27-minute hang).

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >

  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),

  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,

  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.

  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`

- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),

  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +

  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,

  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere

  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +

  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files

  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).

# Rework — PR #1635 (gh-1632 stuck-call recovery)

All open review feedback addressed. **4 lib files touched (comment-only dartdoc refreshes), 2 test fixtures reverted, PR body de-over-claimed.** No production behavior change.

## Issues/Notes

- ⚠️ **IMPORTANT (automated review) — `Closes #1632` over-claim:** the PR body used a closing keyword on gh-1632 while core-tier AC5 (offline orphan-`tool_stuck` ledger REG + red-blocks-merge CI job, I4) and AC6 (fa version in session header, I5) are not implemented anywhere in the repo — merging would auto-close the goal card and silently drop those guarantees. **Fixed in the PR body:** it now opens with `Refs #1632 (partial — the I1 default fix only; the goal card stays open)` plus an explicit note that AC5/AC6 remain open on gh-1632 and must land before the card closes. Implementing AC5/AC6 inside this scoped bugfix would have expanded the PR with two new features; they stay tracked on the goal card, per the review's own next steps.
- ⚠️ **IMPORTANT (automated review) — stale dartdocs contradicting the new default:** all flagged docs updated to the gh-1632 I1 stance (autonomous default in EVERY mode; `advisory` = explicit opt-out only), plus a codebase sweep found and fixed a fourth doc with the same contradiction (`StuckFollowUpAction.advisory` in `agent_loop.dart`, "Advisory only (interactive mode)"):
  - `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart` — `headlessRun` field doc no longer claims it "decides the DEFAULT supervision mode"; now states it does NOT select the supervision default since gh-1632.
  - `lib/src/agent/agent_loop_stuck_supervision.dart` — the advisory paragraph no longer frames advisory as the implicit interactive default ("a human is present"); now an explicit opt-out, with the incident rationale (the 27-minute hang).
  - `lib/src/agent/stuck_tool.dart` — `StuckFollowUpMode` enum doc no longer calls autonomous "headless parity" or advisory "interactive comfort"; autonomous is THE default everywhere, advisory exists solely as an explicit opt-out.
  - `lib/src/agent/agent_loop.dart` — `StuckFollowUpAction.advisory` doc no longer says "Advisory only (interactive mode)"; now states the advisory action happens when the follow-up mode is an explicit `agent.stuckTool.followUp: advisory` opt-out.
- 💡 **SUGGESTION (thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6s4BQf`) — unexplained `apiKey` fixture churn:** confirmed incidental normalization; reverted all flagged literals (`test/cli/cli_config_test.dart:1039`, `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart:239`, `test/cli/stuck_tool_session_test.dart:261`) back to the exact base-branch bytes. Verified: the `apiKey:` lines in both files are now byte-identical to `origin/main` — no phantom `-`/`+` pairs remain in the diff under secret redaction.
